b_01M12F1NRAHFVJ7QPKJVETS5XE.content: The cleaning-job type covers recurring/scheduled hot-tub cleaning maintenance visits for customers, distinct from the one-time tiered restoration packages (Essential/Premium/Platinum) documented at the project level.
b_01M12F1NRAHFVJ7QPKJVETS5XE.falsification_test: If the description changes to something unrelated to tub cleaning, or a job created under this definition addresses full restoration scope rather than routine cleaning, this belief is wrong.
